instruction: Configure VS Code to use 'black' as the default Python code formatting provider.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring VS Code to use black as the Python formatting provider by setting python.formatting.provider to 'black'. Similar complexity to original task - modifies a single setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Expected setting 'python.formatting.provider' is deprecated in modern VS Code Python extensions
Current VS Code uses '[python]': {'editor.defaultFormatter': 'ms-python.black-formatter'} or similar approach
Evaluator may pass even when Black formatter is not actually configured to work
The setting checked may exist but not achieve the instruction's intent (functional Black formatting)
No verification that Black extension/formatter is installed or properly configured
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Update expected setting to modern approach: check for '[python]': {'editor.defaultFormatter': 'ms-python.black-formatter'} in settings.json
Alternatively check for 'editor.defaultFormatter' set to a Black formatter extension ID
Consider verifying that a Black formatter extension is installed (e.g., ms-python.black-formatter)
Update instruction to match the expected setting, or update expected setting to match instruction intent
